label: class_e_03_battle_01
text: Another day, another round of battle study! Osu!\nLet’s get right to it![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_03_battle_02
text: Last time, we learned about Tera Raid Battles!\nDid any of you have a chance to try them out?[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_03_battle_03
text: Tera Pokémon are super strong! And the more\ndifficult ones will use an even tougher tactic that\r\nyou’ll need to deal with.[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_03_battle_04
text: I’m talking about their [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Tera Shield[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_03_battle_05
text: What happens while a Pokémon has its\nTera Shield up, you ask?[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_03_battle_06
text: Well, it’ll take WAAAY less damage, for one![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_03_battle_07
text: It has a big effect on morale, too![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_03_battle_08
text: When Trainers see that shield go up, they feel\ndoomed—like there’s no way to win the battle![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_03_battle_09
text: So, here’s a question for you![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_03_battle_10
text: If the Pokémon you’re battling puts up its Tera\nShield, what should you do?[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_03_select_01
text: Close your eyes and give in

label: class_e_03_select_02
text: Call your parents

label: class_e_03_select_03
text: Terastallize and attack it

label: class_e_03_battle_answer_01
text: What?! Don’t just accept defeat! You should be\nable to find a way out of this predicament if you\r\nkeep on fighting![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_03_battle_answer_02
text: What?! Don’t call your family to tell them you’re\nabout to lose! You should be able to find a way\r\nout of this predicament if you keep on fighting![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_03_battle_answer_03
text: That’s right! You’re a regular Tera Raid Battle\nmaster, aren’t you, new kid?[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_03_battle_11
text: Regular attacks don’t work so well against\nPokémon that have their Tera Shield up.[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_03_battle_12
text:
But having your Pokémon Terastallize is an
effective method to overcome that issue!\c
A Terastallized Pokémon will do more damage
to shielded Pokémon—especially if it uses moves
that match its Tera Type![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_03_battle_13
text: Dealing enough damage to a Pokémon with its\nTera Shield up can destroy the shield and break\r\nthe Pokémon’s stance![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_03_battle_14
text: This means that it’s important to properly time\nyour Terastallizing in Tera Raid Battles.[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_03_battle_15
text: In conclusion![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_03_battle_16
text: As they say, fight fire with fire and Tera\nPokémon with Tera Pokémon![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_03_battle_17
text: Be sure to work together with your teammates to\nsmash through your opponent’s Tera Shield![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_03_battle_18
text: Aw, man! I was just about to suggest we do some\nhands-on practice to really drive the point home,\r\nbut I guess we’re out of time once again...[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_03_battle_19
text: Next class will be our midterm exam! Aim for a\nperfect score! Osu! Osu![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
